articles.summary: New York, NY, September 16, 2024/PRNewswire – Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“LFT” or the “Company”) announced the declaration of a cash dividend of $0.08 per share of common stock with respect to the third quarter of 2024. The dividend is payable on October 15, 2024, to common stockholders of record as of the close of business
articles.title: LFT Declares Q3 2024 Common & Preferred Dividends
